name: kloudia-code
description: AI Coding Agent CLI Harness with multi-agent orchestration, streaming responses, skills engine, and session persistence.

scripts.build: bun build index.ts --target=node --minify --outfile dist/index.js && bun build index.ts --compile --outfile bin/kloudia
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && bun run build
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && bun run build
scripts.release:major: npm version major && bun run build
